note: One image, one day — the world in brief

stories.headline: Ukraine claims drone strikes on Russian ships
stories.summary: Kyiv confirms strikes in the Gulf of Finland and off Libya; Moscow calls them "terrorism" and warns of consequences.

stories.headline: COP31 collapses with no deal
stories.summary: Climate talks in Antalya end without agreement as oil and gas producers block a fossil-fuel phase-out.

stories.headline: CIA and spy chief's office hacked
stories.summary: CNN reports classified systems hit in a breach at the CIA and the Director of National Intelligence.

stories.headline: Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets
stories.summary: A US jury convicts the telecom giant on 10 of 12 counts after a three-month trial in New York.

stories.headline: WHO pulls Ebola staff out of Congo
stories.summary: Workers fled an Ituri hospital after three days sheltering from fighting; 5,775 dead of 11,762 cases.

stories.headline: Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower
stories.summary: Eleven wounded in the Saudi capital as Houthi forces push to within 60 km of Aden in Yemen.

ticker: ALSO TODAY — Trump awards Rudy Giuliani the Medal of Freedom · Gaza death toll reaches 74,746 · NATO to deploy early-warning aircraft to Poland
